description: List the Pokémon that most often share a team with the given Pokémon in a regulation, as the share of its teams that include each one. Use it to find proven partners and cores.

format.description: Regulation id from list_formats. Defaults to "champions-regmc" (Pokémon Champions — Regulation M-C).

limit.description: Maximum entries to return (1–30). Defaults to 10

pokemon.description: Pokémon name in English. Mega Evolutions are tracked separately, e.g. "Charizard-Mega-Y"

name: get_teammates

format.description: Regulation id the result applies to

title: Get a Pokémon's common teammates
